brand.name: Mirrorline Detailing
brand.what: an invented mobile car detailing studio in Toronto: foam wash, clay bar, paint correction, ceramic coating, interior deep clean
brand.audience: car owners who want their car to look new again

idea: From road salt to mirror. A tired winter-grey car rolls into a dark bay; foam cannon in slow motion, water beading off fresh ceramic coating, a polisher sweeping away swirls in one pass, the light bar reflecting perfectly in the hood. End on the gleaming car and the detailer stepping back.

end_card.line: Your car. Like the first day.

notes: Invented business and people, modest wardrobe. Cars are generic, no real car brand badges or logos visible.
